requests.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production eight-frame attack animation sheet for Grave Accord, Lantern Warden. Reference image 1 is the exact established character, costume, lantern attachment and clean dry-ink/matte-gouache finish authority; its three separate views are identity references, NOT the requested animation. Draw exactly EIGHT sequential full-body animation frames of ONE identical Lantern Warden, all facing SOUTH-EAST, arranged left-to-right in a strict FOUR columns by TWO rows grid of equal square cells. Same camera, body scale, skull face, teal civic cap, ragged triangular dark teal overcoat, ivory shirt/cuffs, brown belt/boots and the same single caged brass lantern in HIS LEFT HAND (screen-right hand in this three-quarter front view) in every frame. Preserve two arms/two legs and the physical lantern handle grip. Attack sequence: frame 1 settled neutral with lantern down; frame 2 elbow begins raising lantern; frame 3 lantern lifts to shoulder level; frame 4 clear high raised anticipation, free right hand held close to chest; frame 5 deliberate outward lantern sweep at shoulder height; frame 6 follow-through with coat hem trailing; frame 7 lowers lantern; frame 8 settles toward original neutral, allowing a clean loop back to frame 1. These are actual consecutive poses with small in-between movements, not eight alternate designs or mixed views. Keep boots grounded around the SAME central body pivot at 86 percent of each cell height, fixed facing, no camera movement, no zoom or changing torso dimensions. Each COMPLETE figure, cap, boots, fingertips and lantern inside its OWN cell with at least 10 percent transparent padding; no neighboring overlap. Reserve enough width for the raised lantern. Restrained useful variation in elbow/wrist/coat, stable head/body identity, purposeful broad matte teal/ivory fabric planes, only selected fine face/hand/lantern detail. Match the reference's mature original gothic civic zombie, NOT glossy, 3D, chibi or photorealism. Transparent alpha background, absolutely NO floor or cast shadow, NO checkerboard drawing, NO gridlines, NO numbers/labels/text, NO beams, glow, sparks, aura, particles, motion streaks or duplicated ghost props. Lighting and the lantern's warm opaque panels remain constant; attack hazard/cone will be separate runtime geometry. No extra hats, weapons, ornaments, skeletal tails or redesign. Landscape sheet, four equally spaced cells in each row. Preserve the exact reference character and physical left-hand lantern. The silhouette must read at 150 world pixels tall.
requests.review: Diffuse translucent lantern halo extends outside the silhouette, cell padding is tight and a follow-through arm changes attachment. The native is RGBA, not an opaque replacement backdrop. Preserved and superseded.

requests.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Make a corrected Grave Accord Lantern Warden eight-frame lantern-raise attack animation on GENUINELY CLEAR TRANSPARENT ALPHA. Reference 1 is the first motion attempt: use ONLY its sequential raising/lowering idea. Reference 2 is the EXACT accepted identity and matte finish authority. Correct the first attempt's lantern haze, cramped gutters and unstable arm in follow-through. Exactly EIGHT complete figures, FOUR columns by TWO rows, evenly spaced equal cells. Wide 2:1 sheet if possible. NO diffuse halo, NO haze, NO light cast onto the background, NO floor, NO shadow, NO dark or colored backdrop. Every area outside the clean body/prop silhouette must be fully transparent. Lantern panels are solid MATTE OCHRE with dark ink cage, NO luminous emissions or gradients outside its outline. Body: same mature skull face, teal civic cap, long broad quiet teal ragged coat, bone undershirt, leather belt/boots. Do not add facial expressions or change head size. Same SOUTH-EAST three-quarter front facing in all eight frames, camera stays fixed. Same torso, hips, planted boot positions, clothing proportions and scale in every cell. Only the anatomical LEFT arm raises and lowers the ONE lantern. In this camera the lantern-holding left shoulder and arm are on SCREEN RIGHT. The free anatomical right arm stays on SCREEN LEFT and is always visibly separate, bent calmly near chest. NEVER transfer the lantern to the right hand, never cross arms, never rotate the body into a different profile. Frame sequence: 1 neutral lantern down, 2 left elbow bends to lift, 3 left wrist/lantern at chest level, 4 lantern high in clearly readable anticipation, 5 left arm extends a LITTLE forward while still on screen right, 6 same left arm smoothly returns toward shoulder level, 7 lantern lowers halfway, 8 returns to frame-1 relaxed position. No big body lunge or flapping coat. Distinct but connected animation poses, stable hand-to-handle grip and one lantern cage in all eight frames. Keep the exact reference's dry black ink and opaque matte gouache with at least 75 percent of large fabric planes calm uninterrupted color; focal detail only face/hands/lantern. Each figure including its raised lantern must fit in the INNER 70 PERCENT of its own cell, with generous empty gutters between every pair. Fixed central boot midpoint and foot baseline about 86 percent of each cell height. Entire cap/fingers/boots/lantern always inside cell, no overlaps or cutoffs. No gridlines, numerals, captions, text, particle effects, aura, motion streaks, extra ornaments, ghost arms or duplicated props. Treat this as a real spritesheet production asset, not a concept illustration. All eight subjects on true transparent alpha, with clean antialiased silhouette edges and no surrounding glow. Original identity is unchanged.
requests.review: Native and all eight packed frames inspected on paper/dark teal and at 150px/2x; browser play/pause, frame controls and illustrative hazards observed. Physical-left lantern, facing and silhouette are readable. The generated source has uneven gutters and row/column placement, corrected only by recorded extraction, one shared scale and planted-foot translations. Reference proportions differ slightly between poses; retain as a motion study pending Phaser encounter review, full action library and human approval.
